# Russian smoke-test audio

`russian.wav`: short synthetic Russian speech, generated locally with the macOS
Milena system voice; used solely as an integration-test fixture, not a
training dataset. It is not included in the desktop application archives.

Text: «Привет. Это проверка локального распознавания русской речи.
Сегодня хорошая погода.»

The frozen-app test checks key words rather than exact punctuation.
